notes: renttnt.com redirects to townside.com. The townside.com /leasing page has no fees but says 'Applicants will need a credit score of 650 or higher and income of 3x monthly rental rate to qualify.' Blacksburg leasing for the 27-28 school year starts 10/1. Kept text covers only the first 15 AppFolio listings, about the first third of the page. The notable hidden fee is a $15/month 'Risk Protection Fee'. Pet rent and pet deposit amounts are not stated. Search snippets mentioned a $65-67 application fee and a $100 lease preparation fee, but neither came from a fetched page, so neither is included. Kept out of the catalog: a rental company or scattered houses, not one complex, so one price would mislead.
